intro: A pharmacist resume that shows registration first, then the setting, the volume, and the clinical and service work you led.
tips: Put your registration and number of years up front.
Give the setting and volume: scripts a day, patients, beds.
Show clinical services and improvements you led.

basics.name: Samuel Adeyemi
basics.label: Pharmacist
basics.summary: Registered pharmacist with seven years in community and hospital pharmacy. I make sure patients understand their medicines, and I like improving how a pharmacy runs.

work.name: Greenlane Pharmacy
highlights: Manage a team of nine and a busy dispensary with zero serious dispensing errors in four years.
Started a medicines review service; 600 reviews in its first year.
Run the flu and COVID vaccination clinic, 3,000 doses a season.

work.name: Auckland City Hospital
highlights: Clinical pharmacist on medical wards, reviewing 40 charts a day.
Led a project that cut missed doses on two wards by half.
